row.team_price_text: Core: $10 USD/employee/mo (FAQ: from $10.25); $250/mo flat for 25 or fewer employees
row.evidence: Okta's BambooHR guide: "You can't create new users in BambooHR. An error is returned when an Okta user is assigned to BambooHR and provisioning is enabled." BambooHR publishes no SCIM endpoint; its identity integrations send employees out of BambooHR.
row.notes: Status unchanged from June (none). BambooHR is an HR source of truth: it pushes employees OUT to IdPs (outbound SCIM 2.0 to JumpCloud; Okta and OneLogin import from it) but documents no inbound SCIM endpoint, and its public API index (documentation.bamboohr.com/llms.txt) lists no SCIM resources. IdPs confirm they cannot create users in BambooHR (Okta known issues; JumpCloud). Okta can push profile attribute updates back into existing BambooHR records only. SSO: SAML 2.0 app plus Microsoft sign-in app; the pricing page does not say which plans include SSO (Entra tutorial lists an 'SSO enabled subscription' prerequisite). Pricing: plan cards show Core $10 / Pro $17 / Elite $25 USD per employee per month (the FAQ on the same page gives different figures; see conflicts); companies with 25 or fewer employees pay a flat $250 / $425 / $650 per month. Billing period (monthly vs annual) for the listed per-employee price is not stated. Help-centre search for 'scim' (help.bamboohr.com) returns one result, the outbound JumpCloud SCIM listing, so 'none' meets the searched-everywhere test at medium confidence.

endpoints.purpose: List BambooHR user (login) accounts, filterable by status enabled/disabled
Permanently delete employee record and associated data
Deprecated: exchange credentials for an API key (Marketplace partners only)

rate_limits.text: Undisclosed limits; requests may be throttled with 503 Service Unavailable (Retry-After header may be present).

limitations.text: Calls run with the permissions of the user who owns the API key; fields and employees outside that user's access are not returned or editable.
Employment type and termination date cannot be set through Update Employee; they live on the employmentStatus table.
DELETE on an employee permanently removes the record and all associated data (there is no documented soft deactivate of a user account via the API).

fallbacks.other_sync: Outbound only: BambooHR sends employees to JumpCloud over SCIM 2.0; Okta and OneLogin import employees from BambooHR (HR-driven provisioning into the IdP). Okta can write profile attribute updates back to existing BambooHR records. Microsoft sign-in app for SSO.

conflicts.text: Pricing page plan cards show Core $10 and Pro $17 USD per employee/month, while the FAQ on the same page says pricing starts at $10.25 (Core) and $17.50 (Pro).

Okta's BambooHR catalogue page marks SCIM, Create and Update as checked in its markup, while Okta's BambooHR known-issues page says 'You can't create new users in BambooHR'; the help-doc statement is used.

open_questions: BambooHR does not publish a statement that it has no inbound SCIM; status 'none' rests on the absence of any SCIM endpoint in its public API index plus Okta, Microsoft and JumpCloud docs saying users cannot be provisioned into BambooHR. scim.available is left null because no vendor page says no.
Pricing page does not say which plans include SAML SSO or API access; per-plan sso/user_api flags left null.
Billing period (monthly vs annual) of the listed per-employee prices is not stated on the pricing page.
Is the REST API available on every plan? Getting-started docs do not name a plan requirement; user_api.plan and api_tax left null.

No documented API endpoint creates, disables, reactivates or changes the access level of a BambooHR user (login) account; only GET /api/v1/meta/users lists them. Whether employee create/delete affects user accounts is not documented.
No audit log API found in the public API reference.
Does BambooHR support SAML JIT account creation? Help-centre SAML article (help.bamboohr.com, Salesforce community) is JS-rendered and could not be loaded.
OneLogin catalogue page (onelogin.com/connector/bamboohr) is behind a bot challenge and could not be loaded; onelogin.listed left null and SSO cited from BambooHR's own marketplace listing.
Google Workspace page documents SAML SSO only; it does not say whether auto-provisioning into BambooHR exists, so google.provisioning is null.
